subject: Request for short sandbox keepalive while PO clears
messages:
From: Leah Cooper <leah@pinebrookhealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request for short sandbox keepalive while PO clears

Hi Camila,

Quick note from procurement — we hit an unexpected routing delay with legal on our PO and it looks like formal purchase order issuance will slip by ~7–10 business days. Our clinical team is mid-validation and will lose access to the sandbox environment unless we can get a short interim allowance.

Would Redwood be able to provision a short, non-billable sandbox voucher (7 days) or token credit to keep the pilot live while our PO clears? Suggested amount from the team is ~20,000 tokens (we estimate ~2–3 days of active evaluation per clinician). We can accept an access lock and usage cap; we need the environment to remain identical to the one we shared earlier.

I’ve attached the draft PO and the SOW for context (PO_Draft_Pinebrook_0427.pdf, SOW-v1.docx). Legal is moving this as fast as they can but I wanted to check whether engineering/CS could approve a small temporary keepalive to avoid losing momentum.

Appreciate any help — happy to hop on a 15-min call if that’s easier.

Best,
Leah Cooper
Head of Digital Programs
Pinebrook Health
leah@pinebrookhealth.com
(555) 312-8841

Hi Leah — thanks for the heads-up and for sending the PO draft. Sorry to hear legal hit a snag.

We can provision a short-term keepalive while the PO is in flight. Proposed details:
- Duration: 7 days starting when you confirm
- Capacity: 25,000 tokens (non-billable) or equivalent $1,000 sandbox top-up — whichever you prefer
- Constraints: usage cap + automatic shutdown if consumption exceeds cap; token-level logging turned on and shared with your security contact

Grace and Priyom — can you confirm finance/legal constraints from our side? If we have approval for a limited voucher we’ll put the account on a temporary hold so it won’t auto-charge and attach standard T&Cs for bridge credits.

Leah — please reply with which option you prefer (tokens vs. dollar top-up) and the earliest window you want the 7-day period to start. I can get this provisioned within the hour after internal sign-off.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Sr. Account Executive — Healthcare
